title: Senior Backend Engineer
sourceText:
Senior Backend Engineer

About us
We build payment infrastructure for marketplaces.

Responsibilities
- Design and operate services that move money reliably.
- Partner with product teams on API design.

Requirements
- 5 years of professional backend experience.
- Strong Python skills and production PostgreSQL experience.
- Experience with Docker in production environments.
- Bachelor degree in computer science or a related field.
- Must have worked with distributed systems.

Preferred qualifications
- Kubernetes experience is a plus.
- Kafka experience preferred.

Benefits
Competitive salary and remote-friendly working hours.

title: Data Analyst
sourceText:
Data Analyst

What you will do
Build dashboards and partner with stakeholders across the business.

What we are looking for
- 2 years of analytics experience.
- SQL fluency required for daily reporting work.
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI.
- Excellent communication skills.

Nice to have
- Python for data analysis is desirable.
- Familiarity with dbt ideally.

How to apply
Send your resume to careers@example.com.

annotatorB.text: Experience with Tableau or Power BI

title: DevOps Engineer
sourceText:
DevOps Engineer

About the company
Example Corp runs a multi-region platform for logistics customers.

Responsibilities
- Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployments.
- Improve observability and on-call practices.
- You must be able to participate in an on-call rotation.

Requirements
- 3+ years of DevOps or platform engineering experience.
- Required: Terraform and AWS at scale.
- CI/CD pipeline ownership experience is essential.
- Strong Linux fundamentals needed.

Preferred skills
- GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD is a bonus.

title: Frontend Engineer
sourceText:
Frontend Engineer

What we're looking for
- 3 years building user interfaces with React.
- TypeScript proficiency required.
- Solid understanding of accessibility.

Nice-to-have
- Next.js experience would be a plus.
- Design systems background ideal.

What you will do
Ship features across our web application with designers and backend engineers.

title: Mobile Engineer
sourceText:
Mobile Engineer

We are looking for an engineer who owns features end to end. The role requires four years of mobile development experience. Candidates need strong Kotlin skills for our Android application. Experience shipping apps through the Play Store release process is essential. Swift knowledge for occasional iOS work would be a bonus. We value clear written communication.

title: QA Automation Engineer
sourceText:
QA Automation Engineer

Requirements
- 2 years of test automation experience.
- Playwright or Cypress experience required.
- Applicants must be authorized to work in India.
- Bachelor degree required.

Preferred qualifications
- API testing experience is a plus.

Equal opportunity statement
We are an equal opportunity employer.
